tldr: Mars in Virgo: action is precise, efficient, and aimed at improvement.
body: With Mars in Virgo, drive works through problem-solving, technique, and practical correction. You act by fixing what is broken and refining what can be better.
gift: Skill, discipline, service, and the ability to make effort useful.
challenge: Criticism, anxiety, and burning energy on flaws instead of priorities.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
